items.quote: when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount
items.claim: The people saw that Moses was taking a long time to come down from the mountain.

items.quote: the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron
items.claim: Because Moses was delayed, the people gathered around Aaron.
items.mechanism: Moses' delay led the people to turn to Aaron

items.quote: said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us
items.claim: The people asked Aaron to make them gods to go before them.
items.object: gods, which shall go before us

items.quote: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him
items.claim: The reason the people gave was that they did not know what had happened to Moses, the man who brought them out of Egypt.
items.mechanism: Not knowing what happened to their leader was the reason they gave for asking for gods
